keyFindings.description: Close/reopen undercounts last_seq: loadIssue now runs before the write phase and only len(appended) (the asks' events) is added, so an anchor_refreshed event the asks' document write queues is missed. Repro at head: response last_seq=18, issue reads 19, issue.closed payload last_seq=18; base 19/19/19.

Write advice read before the close's withdrawal (and the reopen's restoration) is queued: a session closing an issue is told your_open_asks lists the asks its own close withdrew (2 at head, 0 at base); a reopen leaves out the restored ones.

A comment edit plans its block index from an unlocked read; IndexOwedItemBlocks takes only the item row and state row, no owner lock, and the edit no longer holds the comment row in its read phase, so the reconciliation can index r+1 between the edit's plan and its write phase, and the edit then writes r+1 again from the stale plan.

MoveApprovalAsk returns its event only when not queued (its one production caller is queued and discards it); RewriteApprovalAsk's queued branch has no production caller. A mode-dependent zero result is a silent trap.
queueWrite's nil-ledger mode serves two callers (issue_claim.go:507, reviews.go:296) and duplicates docs.write/execStep, with different sealed-queue behaviour.
